To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Machine learning is the study of computer algorithms that improve automatically through experience.

1) Machine learning algorithms are useful in a broad range of applications; 2) The field of machine learning is growing rapidly; 3) There are many different machine learning algorithms, and each one is useful for a particular set of problems; 4) Machine learning algorithms can learn from data and improve with experience; and 5) Machine learning algorithms have been applied in many different fields.
Machine learning is the study of algorithms that allow computers to learn from data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of how to construct computer programs that automatically improve with experience.
the design and development of algorithms that can be used to build computer programs that automatically improve with experience.
the development of machine learning algorithms that can be used to solve problems in science, engineering, and commerce.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
machine learning is concerned with the design and development of algorithms and techniques that allow computers to learn.

the main difference between machine learning and statistics is that machine learning is an attempt to build algorithms that can infer models directly from data, whereas statistics is a framework that provides rigorous methods for inferring parameters in models that have been specified a priori.
machine learning is the study of how machines learn.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the main goal of machine learning is to develop algorithms that can learn from data.
we are trying to understand and build systems that exhibit human-like learning.
the machine learning community seeks to extract knowledge from data, and that the data are usually very large.

the use of machine learning in the context of the design of a machine learning algorithm can have a significant effect on the performance of a machine learning system.
the machine learning approach can be used to solve many problems that have been difficult for programmers to solve.
